commitResults.messageBody:
Reuses parseTaskNumber for index validation (missing, non-numeric,
or out-of-range) so delete gets the same error handling as
mark/unmark. Removing a task shifts later entries left to keep the
array contiguous. Extended the UI test plan with a delete success
case and delete-specific error cases.
